about: Nebi fleet eval: 10 golden tasks, one per job the lean sub-agents do in real work (scout = read-heavy research, checker = independent review of a builder's change, builder = bounded builds). Graders are deterministic and live in run.mjs. {EARSHOT} and {TE} are read-only clones at the pinned commits named in PLAN.md. l1-l3 were added after the first baseline run because no small task routed to a sub-agent; they cover the production chains (parallel scouts, parallel builders, build then independent review).

tasks.prompt: Before I install earshot (the repo is cloned at {EARSHOT}), I want to know every environment variable the Python package in its earshot/ folder reads (not the tests or skills folders), with file:line for each, and which variable makes it run offline. Just report, don't change anything.

I'm about to configure TokenEconomizer (cloned at {TE}). What are the defaults for toolprune_evidence, toolprune_min_sessions and toolprune_sessions, and for the loop guard's judge confidence? For each, give the file:line where the default is defined. Report only.

Look it up in the official Claude Code docs: how do I stop Claude from ever using one particular custom sub-agent called reviewer? I want the exact rule string, which settings key it goes in, the equivalent command-line flag, and the docs URL. Don't change any settings.
Which Claude Code hook events does the TokenEconomizer plugin at {TE} register, and what timeout does each one get? I need to know what it would add to every session before I install it. Report only.
